questions.question: How does reverse cursed technique turn cursed energy into positive energy?
questions.subject: Reverse Cursed Technique

answer.item: Reverse cursed technique turns cursed energy into positive energy to regrow missing body parts and heal wounds.

questions.question: What is one of the primary hurdles when using reverse cursed technique?
questions.subject: Reverse Cursed Technique

answer.item: One of the primary hurdles when using it is compensating for blood loss through a technical process that converts a massive amount of cursed energy into blood.

questions.question: Why are cursed spirits vulnerable to positive energy?
questions.subject: Reverse Cursed Technique

answer.item: They are vulnerable to positive energy because it can compromise the integrity of their bodies and destroy them.

questions.question: How can jujutsu sorcerers restore their depleted reverse cursed technique output using Black Flash?
questions.subject: Reverse Cursed Technique

answer.item: Using Black Flash twice in a row allows jujutsu sorcerers to restore their depleted reverse cursed technique output by constructing a unique circuit that distributes its function and burden to different parts of the brain than usual.
